questions.q: In forensic toxicology, the interaction of two or more drugs resulting in an overall effect that is greater than the sum of their individual effects is known as:
questions.explain: Synergism occurs when combined drugs (like alcohol and barbiturates) multiply each other's effects, often leading to lethal outcomes.
